newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt office completes 5-yr bond exchange.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt office completes 5-yr bond exchange.

text.p: Sweden's National Debt Office said on Friday that it had fully completed the exchanges on its new benchmark five year bond, loan 1039.
The total amount was worth 20 billion crowns.
The debt office said in a statement that it had exchanged 18.59 billion crowns of two year paper, loan 1028, and 1.40 billion crowns worth of eight year bonds, loan 1035.

This was the third time the debt office has offered an exchange on existing bonds on a new bond. The system is aimed t boosting liquidity in the new paper quickly. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1017
